### God's Grace and Reward
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-grace-and-reward
Passage: Genesis 38:27-30
Points:
- God's sovereign grace possesses the power to transform even notorious sinners into faithful servants.
- Judah’s genuine repentance over his wrongs toward Tamar illustrates how God uses brokenness to cultivate kingdom leadership.
- Tamar acted in faith to keep the covenant promise alive when Judah's family neglected it.
- God honored Tamar by making her younger twin, Perez, a key ancestor in the messianic lineage of Jesus.
- Believers should never stop praying for or reaching out to people who seem hopelessly lost in sin.
